decision_graph.root_question: single Qwen deep visual representation vs lightweight independent MVC feature encoder
facts: Qwen3.5 and Qwen3-VL differ materially in DeepStack behavior.
Qwen3.5 exposes pre-merger and merged vision representations in reference code.
Public libmtmd provides final encoded media embeddings and positional metadata.
llama.cpp helper can decode already-computed media embeddings.
Dedicated retrieval embedding models receive explicit representation training.
Very small independent feature encoders exist and are not automatically resource-prohibitive.
decision_graph.fused_candidate: QNDRF-1.1 defaults to public projected Qwen token-grid reuse plus strict feature/cache lifetime typing, but keeps pre-merger and MobileCLIP2-S0/DINOv3 baselines alive until matched tests.
promotion_blockers: no target encode-call instrumentation proving zero re-encode
general web unavailable for wider current failure-ecology refresh
negative_constraints: do not persist raw embedding buffers as canonical sensor truth
do not treat runtime slot/media cache as UnifiedDB semantic authority
do not promote Qwen feature reuse because duplicate encoders are aesthetically undesirable
do not judge MVC by closed-set accuracy alone
